resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: INCORRECT as written. Official API FAQ states non-commercial use of the web service is free and directs commercial use to MetaBrainz commercial plans (https://musicbrainz.org/doc/MusicBrainz_API; https://metabrainz.org/supporters/account-type). Original “license agreement” is imprecise—commercial live API use is framed as supporter/commercial account tiers (and contact), not a generic license-only path. Corrected free_tier_limits accordingly. Verifier A over-confirmed; Verifier B’s substance accepted.
free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use of the live web service requires a MetaBrainz commercial supporter plan (or contact MetaBrainz)
